title: Pre-Modern Armies for Worldbuilders, Part III: Paying for It
summary: This is Part III of a worldbuilding series examining how pre-modern societies financed their military forces. The article explores the economic realities of maintaining armies, including payment systems, logistical challenges, and how financial constraints shaped military organization and campaign planning throughout history.
problem_solved: Provides worldbuilders (fiction writers, game designers) with historically accurate frameworks for depicting realistic military economics in pre-modern settings.
why_valuable: It bridges rigorous historical scholarship with creative application, helping creators avoid common anachronisms by understanding the actual costs, payment mechanisms, and economic limitations that governed pre-modern warfare.
